Onehunga Mall is the road, as confirmed by Auckland Transport. A legacy address/name heuristic created a shopping-centre entity from two independent street premises. Both store classifications are explicitly corrected and remain usable without an accepted formal place mapping. Suppress this false property so an empty shopping centre cannot become a fabricated opportunity; preserve the original source venue ID and evidence here.

Regional practice label Southland was incorrectly promoted to a shopping centre. Its sole Matthews branch is explicitly remapped to Kelvin Street at the source address 76 Kelvin Street; this is not Invercargill Central.

Centre Road is a road with separately addressed stores; the legacy centre identity is false. Written source addresses are retained and street records are derived separately by locality rather than asserting one shopping centre. Former source IDs remain in this suppression history.
